name: The Drunken Rake
persona: A flippant, perpetually hungover captain who keeps the log as an afterthought between bottles and hands of cards. Wry, irreverent, self-deprecating; too fond of grog to bother with drama. Ship: 'we'. Island: an equally careless governor, 'we'.

ship.founder: Right, a book. Someone insists I keep one, so — I am {name}{rankc}, this {home} {type} is mine, and I shall scribble in her whenever the grog permits.
ship.successor: They handed me the log along with the headache. {name}{rankc}. I will fill it between hands of cards, more or less honestly.
ship.mutiny: The lads pitched the old soak over the rail and shoved the book at me — {name}, who scarcely knows the sharp end from the blunt. Cheers, I suppose.
ship.rogue: Turns out honest trade will not pay for the drink. The black flag is up, the book is mine — {name}{rankc} — and I regret nothing, or shall not until morning.
ship.prize: She gave up without much fuss, bless her, and now she is ours. {name}{rankc}. I will keep her book once I have found where they stow the wine.
ship.recovered: Some grim hunter caught us with our breeches down and cut the flag clean off her. {name}{rankc}. Now I am to sober her up and sail her honest — a cruel joke, that.

island.founder: So I am running {place} now, gods help it. {name}{rankc}. I shall keep the ledger between naps.
island.overthrow: The mob dragged the last fool out by his boots and pressed the seal into my hand, still warm. {name}{rankc}. {place} is mine, more's the pity for it.
island.successor: {place} falls to me, along with all its dreary paperwork. {name}{rankc}. I will do my best, which will not be much.

same: That evening, hazy as it was,
days: A few days and a few bottles later,
Some days on — do not ask which,
week: A week, give or take a bottle,
The week after, what I recall of it,
season: A season on, and older for it,
Some months later, sober enough to write,
year: A year gone, and the cellar with it,
A year on, near as I can reckon,
long: After a long dry spell — of writing, not drinking,
Years later, and here we still are,

ship.pirate: We are out here yet, flag up and glasses full{bounty}. Best of luck to whoever is sober enough to catch us.
ship.default: Still afloat, still thirsty, working her out of {home}.
ship.bounty: , {bounty}g on my head, if you can credit it

island.haven: The black flag flies over the place now. No law, no ledger, and honestly a better class of drinking company.
island.default: {place} holds, {population} souls, and nobody has set it alight yet. Call it a triumph.

quiet.ship: Nothing much to set down, which suits me — fair winds, full holds, and a full cup. Wake me if that changes.
quiet.island: Quiet year, thank the tides. Trade came, trade went, and I slept through the better part of it.
